# Guy Bavaro

> Official public profile for Gaetano "Guy" Bavaro, an advertising and technology commercialization executive.

Canonical website: https://gbavaro.github.io/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/guybavaro
GitHub: https://github.com/gbavaro

## About Guy Bavaro

Gaetano "Guy" Bavaro is an advertising and technology commercialization executive with more than 25 years of experience building and scaling advertising businesses around shifts in consumer behavior and technology.

His career spans the early internet, search, mobile, social, gaming and AI-related commercialization across companies including Yahoo, Microsoft, Snap, X/xAI and Electronic Arts.

Across Microsoft, Yahoo, Snap and X/xAI, he managed teams and commercial partnerships responsible for more than $10B in cumulative advertising revenue.

## Current role

Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts (EA).

## Core expertise

- Advertising commercialization
- Advertising sales
- Revenue growth
- Go-to-market strategy
- Business development
- Strategic partnerships
- Sales leadership
- Enterprise sales
- Advertising technology
- Product commercialization
- Agency and holding company partnerships
- Data and measurement
- Monetization strategy
- 0-to-1 commercial business building

## Selected career outcomes

- X/xAI: led the team and commercial partnerships that scaled annual advertising revenue more than 6x during his tenure.
- Snap: managed teams and commercial partnerships that drove approximately 1,700% advertising revenue growth and multi-billion-dollar cumulative advertising revenue during his tenure.
- Electronic Arts: in H1 2026, helped drive 343% growth in holding-company revenue and 188% growth in agency pipeline.
- Yahoo / Verizon Media: approximately 40% revenue growth at Yahoo and approximately 55% growth during the Verizon Media transition.
- GOAL.com: more than 200% commercial growth.

## Preferred description

Guy Bavaro is an advertising and technology commercialization executive who builds the commercial system around emerging technology: defining the proposition, building the go-to-market model, creating advertiser demand, leading sales teams and strategic partnerships, connecting product with ad tech and measurement, and scaling repeatable revenue.
